netflix.title: Slachtvee
netflix.overview: Thomas, in his forties, holds an important post in a slaughterhouse. He is engaged to Marie-Rose, the daughter of the director, whom he hopes to follow later. In a routine examination in the hospital, however, he finds out that he has cancer and his days are counted. The upheaval that he suffers as a result, however, does not take long, his decision is certain: he will use the short time to clean up some bad guys. What else can he do now?

netflix.title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
netflix.overview: Before the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame of The A-Team and Rocky III, there was Laurence Tureaud. This is the extraordinary origin story behind one of the most unlikely and beloved icons in entertainment — Mr. T.

amazon-prime-video.title: Neagley
amazon-prime-video.overview: Neagley, drawing from her experience with Jack Reacher and the 110 Special Investigators, embarks on a perilous mission to expose a sinister threat, risking her life to unravel the mystery.

apple-tv.title: Brothers
apple-tv.overview: Matthew and Woody have been best friends for years, but a shocking family secret suggests their connection might be closer.

apple-tv.title: Last Seen
apple-tv.overview: Police dispatcher Ian Ridley's daughter Maggie disappeared years ago. He receives a call, believing it's her, and embarks on a relentless quest to find her and reunite his family, disregarding consequences.

apple-tv.title: Mayday
apple-tv.overview: Lieutenant Troy Brennan's reconnaissance mission over Soviet territory goes awry, forcing him to crash-land and survive in Russian wilderness while evading capture or rescue.

skyshowtime.title: Deadly Ties
skyshowtime.overview: A continuation of the *Śleboda* series, centering on anthropologist Anka Serafin and journalist Sebastian Strzygoń. This time, the story takes us to Upper Silesia.

hayu.title: Still Flipping Out
hayu.overview: Follows Lewis as he navigates the hilariously unpredictable nature of his professional and personal lives as his trademark spontaneity collides with the people who work with him, for him, and still somehow survive him.

hbo-max.title: A Killer Story
hbo-max.overview: Investigative journalist Joe Sexton looks into a 2002 double homicide case in Kansas after receiving thousands of emails from Eileen Umbehr, a homemaker turned citizen sleuth. Eileen and her husband Keen are convinced that Dana Chandler, the woman accused of killing her ex-husband and his girlfriend, did not commit the crime and devote their lives to fighting for Chandler's innocence.

hbo-max.title: 9/11: Days That Shocked the World
hbo-max.overview: The terrorist hijackings and destruction of the Twin Towers were a defining moment in human history. Nearly 3,000 people were killed, triggering the war on terror and changing the way we live today. Rescue workers, survivors and witnesses relive the traumatic events of 9/11, some telling their story for the first time.

mubi.title: JAŸ-Z in 8
mubi.overview: Thirty years after his landmark debut album, artist, icon, philanthropist, and entrepreneur JAŸ-Z sits down with longtime friend, producer, and director Rick Rubin for an intimate reflection on his storied career.

mubi.title: Pulp: What Do You Do for an Encore?
mubi.overview: A fusion of the brilliantly choreographed stage spectacle of Pulp’s biggest ever arena show — part of the global tour for More, the band’s first album in 24 years — with four decades of colorful, never-seen-before archival material.

bloodstream.title: Last Chance Motel
bloodstream.overview: A newlywed couple's dream wedding spirals into a bloody nightmare when they uncover that their secluded venue- a desolate motel deep in the Nevada desert- is run by a relentless bloodthirsty family with dark secrets, revealing that one bride's future may not be all that it was promised to be.

bloodstream.title: V/C/R/01
bloodstream.overview: A disturbing analog horror anthology unfolds through recovered VHS tapes and surveillance footage, revealing terrifying encounters with mysterious entities, a human experiment, a desperate emergency call, and a horrifying discovery

kableone.title: Mitti de Putt
kableone.overview: Two villages are bound by a rivalry that has outlived the men who started it. For one young man, the feud stops being history the day his uncle murders his grandparents and carries his mother away.
